paper_concerns: No photocatalyst at all: Cl radicals from chlorinated solvents under 415 nm light at 130 °C (photothermal). Eligibility should be checked against the catalyst/visible-light criteria; heating to 90-130 °C is substantial and a dark control still gave Mn 30.8 kDa.
Fig. 2a and Fig. 3b are tables inside figures; most entry values (Mn/Mw of P1-P5, OPP2-5, MixPP; exact TPA yields for entries 1, 2, 4) are not in text.

Not covered by tasks: 90 °C run (comparable Mn, Supplementary Table S3); OPP1-OPP5 final Mn 12.6-15.5 kDa (range); solvent-type screen Mn 11-17 kDa (range); recycling runs 92.4~94.9% TPA (range); OPP5-fed run 48.1% TPA; no-PP and no-light PET controls giving 'no TPA' (Fig. 3b entries 5-6) which could be control records with 0 yield.
